metadata.title: RaUF: Learning the Spatial Uncertainty Field of Radar
metadata.authors: Shengpeng Wang, Kuangyu Wang, Wei Wang
metadata.venue: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR 2026)

claimChecks.finding: Intensity+Doppler range/azimuth/elevation input; range-angle uncertainties transformed to Cartesian covariance; LiDAR frustum occupancy labels supervise the model.
The stated relation assumes a target stationary relative to the ground; not an unrestricted dynamic-scatterer guarantee.

CD/F-score, CPR(distance0.5m to LiDAR points), transformation estimation and ego-velocity. Part of cross-scene/sensor evaluation involves fine-tuning; no independent free/unknown ECE/Brier, future occupancy, or planner safety endpoint is established.

claimChecks.evidenceLocation: fresh CVF HTML + official PDF + arXiv abs
claimChecks.finding: CVPR2026 pp42474-42483; canonical arXiv2603.01026 retained since no formal DOI was verified. Crossref title search returned three unrelated records, not a DOI match.

tokenChecks.role: String absence corroboration only, not a semantic proof of absent calibration.

metadata.title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
metadata.authors: Quinlan Sykora, Sourav Biswas, Christopher Diehl, Andrew Cunningham, Thomas Gilles, Raquel Urtasun
metadata.venue: European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026, accepted)

reading.notes: Read task/method/evaluation and the cited supplementary protocol/limitations; TriO S4.SS3 read the task/experiment prose, with detailed runtime from Table10. This is not an all-pages claim.

claimChecks.finding: Continuous q=(x,y,z,t) predicts occupancy, obstacle probability and3Dflow. AV2 uses3s history/3s future; LRR uses0.5s history/1.5s future. TriO is existing evidence of this combination, not merely a future proposal.

claimChecks.evidenceLocation: S4 dataset introduction, C.1, B.6, S4.SS3
claimChecks.finding: AV2/STU have no radar. Radar evidence is LRR, which is unreleased. Metric3Dv2 pretraining is not globally label-free; supervised downstream occupancy fine-tuning uses vehicle bounding boxes.

Combine only train-ground negative points with val-obstacle positive points; front-camera FOV and z[-3,5]m filters; occupancy<0.5 assigned ground; operating point maximizes F1 on the combined evaluation set. Different task/split from standard unknown-semantic hidden-test STU.
AV2 training sequences700 vs750; STU22 vs2train+19val. Both discrepancies are recorded rather than silently resolved.
NVIDIA RTX5000,20k queries: full TriO489.32ms; no-camera60.81ms. Planner-query count is a proxy workload, not a closed-loop planner run.
Tangential flow failure/warped occupancy inconsistency, snow/exhaust false positives, low obstacles missed. Closed-loop motion planning outside paper scope.

claimChecks.evidenceLocation: ECCV dedicated poster4951 and parent archived official accepted list
claimChecks.finding: Accepted ECCV2026 destination is public; no dedicated Springer chapter/independent formal DOI was verified. Keep accepted, official venue URL and arXiv link.

metadata.title: RCVLA: 4D Radar-Grounded Semantic Reasoning and Trajectory Arbitration for Autonomous Driving
metadata.authors: Lianqing Zheng, Xiaokai Bai, Yixuan Luo, Runwei Guan, Minghao Liu, Zhiqiang Wei, Hui-liang Shen, Xichan Zhu, Zhixiong Ma

reading.notes: Read task/method/evaluation and the cited supplementary protocol/limitations; TriO S4.SS3 read the task/experiment prose, with detailed runtime from Table10. This is not an all-pages claim.

claimChecks.finding: Sem aligns camera/radar tokens and produces reference trajectories plus object/occupancy queries. Phys uses five priors, structured query/radar-cluster conditioning, truncated diffusion and TTC score calibration.

Cap4DR86016 pairs only pretraining; all downstream uses OmniHD-QA520161 QA pairs split358185/161976 samples. No released sequence-level split list or sequence isolation algorithm is specified in the read text; counts are not independent scenes.
1/2/3s average L2: Sem0.348m,Phys0.259m. Average open-loop collision Sem0.576%,Phys0.175%. Not real-vehicle or closed-loop collisions.
Sem full collision0.576% vs without4D radar0.391%, despite semantic metric gains. Do not infer safety from language alignment scores.

Constant planar velocity uses compensated radial-velocity vectors; delay robustness ages only reference trajectory while object/occupancy/radar conditions remain current. Not complete tangential dynamics or whole-sensor-delay testing.

references.note: This check supports incremental review integration only; it is not independent approval of the separately written RCVLA full report.
